_comment1: Copy to web/config.json (gitignored) to enable the deep-think route (docs/PROTOCOL-deep-think.md). Feature is off entirely while the file is absent or enabled=false.
_comment2: provider 'openai-chat' speaks the /chat/completions dialect: point base_url at a second llama-server for the local big-model path (see Makefile deep-model target), or at https://api.openai.com/v1 / any aggregator. 'openai-responses' speaks the /responses surface. 'anthropic' speaks /v1/messages and requires the key.
_comment3: api_key_env names an environment variable; the key itself never lives in this file. Local providers need no key — leave api_key_env unset.

face._comment: opt-in face recognition (docs/PROTOCOL-face-recognition.md); embeddings stay local in web/faces.json. 'ambient' adds the frame-at-speech-onset context line (docs/PROTOCOL-ambient-face.md); needs enabled too, plus the per-session UI toggle.

mcp._comment1: opt-in MCP tool servers (docs/PROTOCOL-mcp-selection.md, implementation section). Each server's tools join the planner manifest namespaced as <server>__<tool>; >20 connected tools switch the manifest to the measured coarse gate (k=5 top-2 shortlist).
mcp._comment2: env values MUST be "$ENV_NAME" references — a literal value for a TOKEN/KEY/SECRET/PASSWORD key is refused at startup. Tools whose name implies a mutation (create/write/delete/commit/push/navigate/...) park for a spoken confirm before running; set "confirm": false on a server to downgrade that, true to force it for every tool.
mcp._comment3: a server is enabled here only after its per-server frozen eval passes (MS-16b: pos>=0.60, neg>=20/24). timeout_s bounds each tools/call.
mcp._comment4: remote servers: "url" instead of cmd/args — Streamable HTTP (entry BD). No auth yet (deferred): only no-auth endpoints connect; a 401/403 fails honestly at startup. Remote servers pass the same MS-16b gate before enabling.
